main_text.p: monstrent, ἀγλωσσῃ[?] Φίλον, ἀλλ᾽ ἐγγῳ[?] Simul enim cum humanissimis tuis literis accepi codicis Samaritani, qvi penes vos est Judaico textu varietates. Rem mihi perjucundam fecisti, & magnorum Bibliorum apparatui instruendo perutilem, alias,non ego tantum habeo tibi gratias, sed habebit publica rei Christianæ utilitas. Triumtantum LibrorumMosaicorum cum textu Hebræo collationem ad me misisti, duorum,qvi superfunt collationem eadem animi tui benevolentia fretus, te missurum spero, atqve cùm occasio sese obtulerit, ut mittas impensissime rogo. Paucis, Vir amplissime, qvoniam res ipse id mecum qvodammodo expostulat, & tu ansam præbes, de Samaritanis codicibus disseram: paucis, inqvam, nam temporis brevitate plurimum urgeor, nec præsentissimum tabellarii discessum negligere debeo, ne officii mei longiori comperendinatione, beneficii tui immemor, vel tantisper exîstimer. Sunt mihi qvatuor exemplaria manuscripta codicis Hebræo-Samarita-ni,

page.notes: Top line Greek is partly worn; the Greek words are uncertain and marked [?]. "Triumtantum" and "LibrorumMo" / "saicorum" join across the line end where the printed break is only a dot, not a hyphen; left as printed. "debeo" is followed by a small mark (possibly a comma or asterisk) read as a comma. "exîstimer" printed with a circumflex-like mark over the i, kept as shown. Catchword "ni," and signature "P 4" are page furniture. Digitiser stamp "Digitized by G" omitted.
